results.name: Bench Alternating Step Ups
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, then bring your left foot up to meet your right foot, standing fully on the bench.
Step down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, and then repeat the movement with your left foot stepping up first.
Continue alternating step ups on bench in a controlled, rhythmic manner.
tips: Ensure the bench is stable and secure before beginning the exercise to avoid slipping or tipping.
Maintain an upright posture, keeping your chest lifted and shoulders back to ensure proper form.
Focus on driving through your heel as you step up to maximize glute and leg engagement.
results.description: Bench Alternating Step Ups is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bench Bulgarian Split Squats Left
instructions: Stand a few feet in front of a bench with your back to the bench.
Extend your left leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your right knee, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, and repeat the movement.
tips: Focus on keeping your torso upright and avoid leaning forward to ensure proper form.
Use a mirror or ask for feedback to ensure your knee stays aligned with your foot and doesn’t cave inward.
Keep your movements smooth and controlled, ensuring you lower and lift yourself with even tempo.
results.description: Bench Bulgarian Split Squats Left is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bench Bulgarian Split Squats Right
instructions: Stand a few feet in front of a bench with your back to the bench.
Extend your right leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your left knee, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, and repeat the movement.
tips: Focus on keeping your torso upright and avoid leaning forward to ensure proper form.
Use a mirror or ask for feedback to ensure your knee stays aligned with your foot and doesn’t cave inward.
Keep your movements smooth and controlled, ensuring you lower and lift yourself with even tempo.
results.description: Bench Bulgarian Split Squats Right is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bent Knee Back to Side Kick
instructions: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Lift your right knee off the floor and extend it backward while keeping it bent at a 90-degree angle.
Bring your right knee back down to the starting position.

Lift your right knee out to the side until it is parallel to the floor, then return it to the starting position. Repeat the movement on the left side after completing the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your head in a neutral position, looking down at the floor to maintain proper alignment.
Focus on squeezing your glutes during the movement to enhance muscle activation.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it.
results.description: Bent Knee Back to Side Kick is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Bent Leg Side Kick (Kneeling)
instructions: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Lift your right knee off the floor in a swift motion and raise it sideways until it is level with your hip, keeping your leg bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lower your right knee back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
tips: Ensure your hands are directly under your shoulders to provide a stable base for the movement.
Focus on engaging your glutes as you lift your leg to enhance muscle activation.
Avoid leaning to the side; keep your upper body stable during the exercise.
results.description: Bent Leg Side Kick (Kneeling) is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Bodyweight Calf Raises
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides for balance.
Lift your heels off the floor, rising onto your toes.
Hold the top position briefly, squeezing your calf muscles.
Lower your heels back to the floor in a controlled manner and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Stand tall with your shoulders back and chest lifted to maintain good posture.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your weight is evenly distributed on your toes to maintain balance and stability.
results.description: Bodyweight Calf Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shins.

results.name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended by your sides for support. Place one foot on a box and cross the opposite ankle over the thigh of your working leg, forming a figure-four shape.
Engage your glutes and squeeze them to lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knee.
Pause at the peak of the movement for a second and slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
tips: Keep your shoulders flat on the ground and your head relaxed throughout the movement.
Engage your core to prevent arching your lower back.
Use your working heel to press into the elevated surface and drive the lift.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended by your sides for support. Place both feet on an elevated surface, with one foot flat and the other slightly forward so only the heel rests on the edge.
Engage your glutes and squeeze them to lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knee.
Pause at the peak of the movement for a second and slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
tips: Keep your shoulders flat on the ground and your head relaxed throughout the movement.
Engage your core to prevent arching your lower back.
Use your working heel to press into the elevated surface and drive the lift.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Bodyweight Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.
Step forward with your right foot and lower your body by bending both knees, ensuring your front knee is aligned over your ankle and your back knee is close to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left foot stepping forward, alternating legs.
tips: Keep your core engaged and your torso upright to maintain balance and proper form.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid putting unnecessary strain on your knee.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Forward Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Front Raise
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, your torso leaning slightly forward, and both arms extended between your thighs.
Begin to straighten your legs to rise into a standing position while simultaneously raising both arms straight overhead.
Fully extend your legs and arms, standing tall with your arms overhead.
Lower your body back into the squat position, bringing your arms back down between your thighs. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement to protect your back and improve stability.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes during the squat to avoid putting strain on your knees.
Focus on a controlled descent back into the squat to ensure smooth and effective movement.
results.description: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Front Raise is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.
